### CheckpointStorage

[Complete declaration module](/reference-inputs/local-pin-1.3/web/dist/storage/checkpoint.d.ts)

```ts
export declare class CheckpointStorage {
    static open(factory: IDBFactory, name?: string): Promise<CheckpointStorage>;
    close(): void;
    /** The host captures coverage from the same engine state as bytes. Publication acknowledges only completion. */
    publish(input: Checkpoint, coveredUpdateIds: readonly string[]): Promise<{
        state: "checkpointCommitted";
        durability: IDBTransactionDurability | "unknown";
    }>;
    /** Rust callback validates semantic checkpoint bytes and replays the retained tail before exposing a document. */
    restore<T>(expectedInput: JournalIdentity, restore: (state: RecoveryState) => T): Promise<{
        value: T;
        recovery: RecoveryState;
    }>;
}
```

## Contract and outcomes

flush accepts exactly target: local and returns a Promise<void>; observe state.localCommitted for its local receipt. recoveryExport returns bounded recoverable data. CheckpointStorage.open takes an IDBFactory and optional database name; publish takes a Checkpoint and exact covered update IDs. restore validates through the supplied engine callback. Close a separately opened store.

## Errors and recovery

Quota, transaction failure, checksum/identity mismatch or recovery rejection require retaining the original bytes. Export a backup, repair capacity or assets and reopen compatibly. Do not silently clear storage or downgrade schemas.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

CheckpointStorage is exported as an advanced browser adapter, not a hosted service. Its checkpointCommitted acknowledgment is distinct from a document localCommitted update and a qualified remote durability receipt.
